audience.persona: busy professional who suspects small recurring charges are adding up
audience.pain: auditing statements by hand is tedious, so it never gets done
audience.desire: the same answer without spending an evening on a spreadsheet

strategy.disruption_target: the old habit of using spreadsheets and manual statement review as a responsible default
strategy.claim_support: The split-frame shows manual spreadsheeting versus the app result side by side, letting the viewer infer the time-cost contrast immediately.
strategy.promise: Get the same answer in about a minute, not an evening.
strategy.objection_addressed: Can't I just check my statements myself?

visual.style: clean editorial split-frame, single teal accent, light background
visual.scene: a wide split frame contrasting a cluttered manual spreadsheet with the clean Tally dashboard
visual.subject: a side-by-side 'by hand' vs 'Tally' comparison
visual.composition: wide landscape split down the center, simple labels along the top, a clean band along the bottom reserved for overlay text
visual.focal_point: the clean Tally side with the highlighted monthly total
props: a messy spreadsheet on the left
a Tally app card on the right
visual.lighting: soft, even studio light across both halves

product.representation: the advertiser's own app UI on the right half (Tally)

copy.headline: Stop auditing statements by hand
copy.primary_text: Combing your statements by hand works — once. Tally finds the same recurring charges in about a minute, every month.

layout.typography: bold sans, high contrast, generous size
layout.safe_zones: keep labels and key UI within the central 90%; clear ~6% on every edge; reserve the bottom band for overlay text

prompting.final_image_prompt: A wide landscape split-frame comparison on a plain off-white background. Left half labeled 'By hand': a cluttered, messy spreadsheet of rows and numbers. Right half labeled 'Tally': a clean mobile app dashboard card showing a highlighted monthly total '$312/mo' in teal with a small 'Tally' wordmark. A clear vertical divider down the center, simple labels at the top, and a clean empty band along the bottom for overlay text. Soft, even studio lighting.

qa.readability_check: Two-side contrast reads instantly even at small size; the clean Tally side wins the eye.
qa.native_platform_check: Editorial but candid; fits Meta feed and landscape/right-column placements.
policy_risks: Compares against the generic 'by hand' method, not a named competitor; the dollar figure is illustrative sample data, not a real user's result.
qa.iteration_notes: Test a 1:1 crop of the Tally half as a standalone; A/B the top labels.
